description: This file defines the SaveLeaveTypeController class which extends an abstract Vue controller. It handles pre-render logic for leave type forms, initializing Vue components based on whether an ID attribute is present in the request.

classes.name: SaveLeaveTypeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the leave type form, either for editing an existing leave type (if 'id' is provided) or for creating a new one.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, setting it to either 'leave-type-edit' with an ID property or 'leave-type-save' depending on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
